description: Empirical insertion-propensity analysis: amino-acid composition log-odds of hydrophobic cores, anchors vs signal peptides
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_predict, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
OUT="/agent/jobs/2b70b38c-2ea5-4319-89cb-da475f3f6965/provenance"
AAs="ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY"
KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,
        M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)

def usearch(q,cap=1500,fields="accession,organism_name,ft_signal,ft_transmem,sequence"):
    out=[];r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
        params={"query":q,"size":500,"format":"tsv","fields":fields},timeout=180)
    while True:
        L=r.text.rstrip("\n").split("\n");hdr=L[0].split("\t");out+=[l.split("\t") for l in L[1:]]
        nx=r.links.get("next",{}).get("url")
        if not nx or len(out)>=cap: break
        r=requests.get(nx,timeout=180)
    return pd.DataFrame(out[:cap],columns=hdr)
spdf=usearch('(reviewed:true) AND (taxonomy_id:2759) AND (ft_signal_exp:*) AND (length:[150 TO 900])')
sadf=usearch('(reviewed:true) AND (taxonomy_id:2759) AND (ft_transmem:"Signal-anchor for type II membrane protein") AND (length:[150 TO 900])')

def hcore(s,a,b,win=15):
    """most hydrophobic 15-mer inside the annotated feature [a,b] (1-based)"""
    sub=s[a-1:b]
    if len(sub)<win: return sub
    kd=np.array([KD.get(c,0.) for c in sub])
    i=int(np.argmax([kd[i:i+win].mean() for i in range(len(sub)-win+1)]))
    return sub[i:i+win]

H={"signal":[],"anchor":[]}
for _,r in spdf.iterrows():
    m=re.search(r"SIGNAL (\d+)\.\.(\d+)",r["Signal peptide"] or "")
    if m and int(m.group(2))-int(m.group(1))+1>=15:
        H["signal"].append(hcore(r["Sequence"],int(m.group(1)),int(m.group(2))))
for _,r in sadf.iterrows():
    m=re.search(r"TRANSMEM (\d+)\.\.(\d+)",r["Transmembrane"] or "")
    if m and int(m.group(1))<=45 and int(m.group(2))-int(m.group(1))+1>=15:
        H["anchor"].append(hcore(r["Sequence"],int(m.group(1)),int(m.group(2))))
H={k:[x for x in v if len(x)==15 and set(x)<=set(AAs)] for k,v in H.items()}
print("h-cores: signal",len(H["signal"]),"anchor",len(H["anchor"]))

def comp(seqs):
    c=np.zeros(20)
    for s in seqs:
        for ch in s: c[AAs.index(ch)]+=1
    return (c+1)/(c.sum()+20)
cS,cA=comp(H["signal"]),comp(H["anchor"])
LO=np.log(cA/cS)                       # positive = TM-anchor-like residue
tbl=pd.DataFrame({"aa":list(AAs),"freq_SP_hcore":cS.round(4),"freq_anchor":cA.round(4),
                  "log_odds_anchor_vs_SP":LO.round(3)}).sort_values("log_odds_anchor_vs_SP",ascending=False)
print("\n--- amino-acid log-odds in the hydrophobic core (anchor vs signal peptide) ---")
print(tbl.to_string(index=False))

def lo_score(s): return float(np.mean([LO[AAs.index(c)] for c in s if c in AAs]))
sS=np.array([lo_score(s) for s in H["signal"]]); sA=np.array([lo_score(s) for s in H["anchor"]])
# honest out-of-sample check: 5-fold CV refitting LO on training folds only
X=H["signal"]+H["anchor"]; y=np.r_[np.zeros(len(H["signal"])),np.ones(len(H["anchor"]))]
cv=StratifiedKFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=1); oof=np.zeros(len(y))
for tr,te in cv.split(X,y):
    cs=comp([X[i] for i in tr if y[i]==0]); ca=comp([X[i] for i in tr if y[i]==1]); lo=np.log(ca/cs)
    for i in te: oof[i]=np.mean([lo[AAs.index(c)] for c in X[i]])
print(f"\nout-of-sample AUC of composition log-odds score: {roc_auc_score(y,oof):.3f}")

PAN={"Q9UTR0":("S. pombe Sil1",20,42),"A0AAF0AWX6":("S. osmophilus Sil1",1,26),
     "S9PXT1":("S. octosporus Sil1",1,27),"S9VUR3":("S. cryophilus Sil1",1,26),
     "Q08199":("S. cerevisiae Sil1",1,19),"Q9H173":("H. sapiens SIL1",1,31),
     "P16474":("S. cerevisiae Kar2 (SP)",1,42),"P11021":("H. sapiens BiP (SP)",1,18),
     "O14638":("H. sapiens ENPP3 (anchor)",12,30),"P07306":("H. sapiens ASGR1 (anchor)",41,59)}
rows=[]
for acc,(lab,a,b) in PAN.items():
    s=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
    core=hcore(s,a,b)
    seg=s[a-1:b]
    rows.append(dict(name=lab,acc=acc,hcore=core,lo_score=round(lo_score(core),3),
                     pct_in_SP=round(100*float((sS<lo_score(core)).mean()),1),
                     pct_in_anchor=round(100*float((sA<lo_score(core)).mean()),1),
                     polar_in_seg=sum(c in "STNQYGCHDEKRP" for c in seg), seg_len=len(seg)))
P=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\n--- composition log-odds of the hydrophobic core ---")
print(P.to_string(index=False))
P.to_csv(f"{OUT}/hcore_composition_logodds.csv",index=False); tbl.to_csv(f"{OUT}/aa_logodds_table.csv",index=False)
pv=P.loc[P.acc=="Q9UTR0","lo_score"].values[0]
print(f"\nS. pombe Sil1 h-core '{P.loc[P.acc=='Q9UTR0','hcore'].values[0]}' score {pv}: "
      f"{(sS<pv).mean()*100:.0f}th pct of SP cores, {(sA<pv).mean()*100:.0f}th pct of anchor cores")
print(f"signal cores {sS.mean():.3f}+/-{sS.std(ddof=1):.3f} ; anchor cores {sA.mean():.3f}+/-{sA.std(ddof=1):.3f} ; "
      f"Mann-Whitney p={stats.mannwhitneyu(sS,sA).pvalue:.2e}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.8))
ax[0].hist(sS,bins=40,alpha=.6,color="#2e86ab",density=True,label=f"signal-peptide h-core (n={len(sS)})")
ax[0].hist(sA,bins=40,alpha=.6,color="#e09f3e",density=True,label=f"type II anchor core (n={len(sA)})")
ax[0].axvline(pv,color="#d1495b",lw=2.5); ax[0].annotate("S. pombe Sil1",(pv,2.2),color="#d1495b",fontsize=9,ha="right")
ax[0].set_xlabel("mean amino-acid log-odds (anchor vs signal peptide), 15-residue core")
ax[0].set_ylabel("density"); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_title(f"A  Hydrophobic-core composition, out-of-sample AUC {roc_auc_score(y,oof):.2f}")
o=tbl.sort_values("log_odds_anchor_vs_SP")
ax[1].barh(o["aa"],o["log_odds_anchor_vs_SP"],
           color=["#2e86ab" if v<0 else "#e09f3e" for v in o["log_odds_anchor_vs_SP"]])
pomb=P.loc[P.acc=="Q9UTR0","hcore"].values[0]
ax[1].set_xlabel("log-odds: anchor-enriched (right) vs signal-peptide-enriched (left)")
ax[1].set_title(f"B  Residue preferences\nS. pombe Sil1 core: {pomb}")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
